items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I respect Wynton, because I’ve worked with Wynton and he’s got an incredible mind.

ctx.x: So in 1987 I won an Ace award which is the cable equivalent of an Emmy. Back then they had Emmys for broadcast television, and the Ace for cable television. A couple of years later they merged and became the same thing, but it was the same thing. The crowded theater in Hollywood, the searchlights outside, tuxedos, you know. And so I won it as a writer for my “History of Jazz” series, before Ken Burns, and so what I said was — I practiced this — was that I thanked all the people you’re supposed to thank — David…
